Existing actual capturing fixtures remain; test observations decode native writes with UseNumber and run real renderers. Audit binding moves from owner composition to Root, using the existing public retained facade and existing Communication.TypeAnnouncement resource value. SetChanges runs only for non-nil changes; encoding failure never calls Create and raw Create errors remain. Rules844, epoch72 and composition1657 unchanged; Communication compose1514->1486, totalcompose34612->34584, announcement service file cap1183->1178. No new permission, Go type alias, classification, exception, graph field or increased budget. Routes/responses/goldens/IoT, relationship permissions, sessions and wrong-portal rejection unchanged.
